scenarios.name: should respect lexical shadowing
scenarios.given: identifiers with names shared by inner and outer scopes
scenarios.then: the nearest lexical binding is returned, or null for an unresolved name

scenarios.name: should resolve stable aliases
scenarios.given: simple unreassigned variables and assertion or satisfies wrappers

scenarios.name: should stop unresolved and cyclic aliases
scenarios.given: reassigned variables, destructured declarations, parameters, or cycles
scenarios.then: an uncertain original expression is retained without infinite recursion

scenarios.name: should read optional arguments safely
scenarios.given: a call or constructor with fewer arguments than requested
scenarios.then: null is returned instead of assuming an argument exists

scenarios.name: should unwrap every supported TypeScript value wrapper
scenarios.given: as, satisfies, angle-bracket, or non-null assertions, including nested wrappers and stable aliases
scenarios.then: the original runtime expression is returned without treating the asserted type as runtime evidence

scenarios.name: should preserve binding identity when unwrapping syntax
scenarios.given: an identifier wrapped in TypeScript assertions
scenarios.then: the identifier is returned without following its initializer
